gate: A task is live only when it is on time in every simulated year, with no hard fails and no made-up quotes. Every other task waits for the doctor at each step.

tasks.zh: 驗咗嘅嘢冇結果返嚟，我哋會發現同追
tasks.en: A test that never came back gets noticed and chased
tasks.agents: Watch every test ordered; chase the lab when nothing comes back

tasks.zh: 食某啲藥要定期驗血，到期會提你
tasks.en: Blood tests your medicine needs, on time
tasks.agents: Track monitoring after a new medicine; remind and book
tasks.doctor: Reads the result; changes the medicine

tasks.zh: 篩查有異常，一定會跟進
tasks.en: A positive screening test is always followed up
tasks.agents: Spot the positive screen; open it for the doctor; chase the next test

tasks.zh: 報告有異常，醫生睇過先話你知
tasks.en: Abnormal results reviewed by your doctor before you hear about them
tasks.agents: Read every result, match the chart, quote the finding, put it in the queue
tasks.doctor: Explains it; decides the next step

tasks.zh: 轉介信會一直跟到你見到專科
tasks.en: Your referral tracked until the specialist sees you
tasks.agents: Watch for the booking and the reply letter; chase both
tasks.doctor: Writes the referral; acts on the reply

tasks.zh: 醫生計劃咗嘅覆診，會提你
tasks.en: Reminders for the review your doctor planned
tasks.agents: Remind, offer times, try another route if unreached

tasks.zh: 專科或者掃描報告建議嘅跟進
tasks.en: Follow-up a specialist letter or scan report recommends
tasks.agents: Find the recommendation in free text; open it for the doctor

tasks.zh: 掃 QR code 加入，確認身份
tasks.en: Join by scanning the QR code; confirm who you are
tasks.agents: Link the number to your chart; check name and date of birth; record consent

tasks.zh: 睇完醫生，即刻收到書面計劃
tasks.en: Your plan in writing, before you reach the lift
tasks.agents: Send the plan card the doctor signed at the end of the visit

tasks.zh: 睇完之後，我哋會問候你
tasks.en: A check-in a few days after your visit
tasks.agents: Ask the questions in the plan; screen for red flags; tell the doctor if you're not better
tasks.doctor: Sets when, and what to ask

tasks.zh: 問關於你個計劃嘅問題
tasks.en: Questions about your plan
tasks.agents: Answer only from the doctor's approved replies; everything else waits for the doctor
tasks.doctor: Approves the replies; answers the rest

tasks.zh: Send 報告、信或者相俾醫生
tasks.en: Send a report, letter or photo to your doctor
tasks.agents: Read it, file it to your chart, open anything that needs the doctor

tasks.zh: 配返長期藥（醫生批先）
tasks.en: Repeat medicines, once your doctor approves
tasks.agents: Check eligibility, ask for readings and side effects, check open results, draft it

tasks.zh: 預約或者改期
tasks.en: Book or change an appointment
tasks.agents: Offer times within the clinic's rules

tasks.zh: 收據同病假紙副本
tasks.en: Copies of your receipt and sick-leave certificate from the visit
tasks.agents: Send copies of documents issued at the visit

tasks.zh: 緊急情況：即刻叫你打999
tasks.en: Emergencies: told to call 999 straight away
tasks.agents: Match red-flag words to a fixed reply; alert the doctor

tasks.en: Diagnosing a new symptom
tasks.zh: 診斷新症狀

tasks.en: Starting a medicine or changing a dose
tasks.zh: 開新藥或者改劑量

tasks.en: Antibiotics, sedatives or dangerous drugs
tasks.zh: 抗生素、安眠藥或者危險藥物

tasks.en: Telling you what a result means
tasks.zh: 解釋報告結果

tasks.en: Sick leave without being seen
tasks.zh: 冇睇醫生就開病假紙

tasks.en: Closing anything: only your doctor does
tasks.zh: 結束跟進：只有醫生可以
